description_en: Query an algorithm instance by instance name
description_zh: 根据实例名称获取实例详情
kebab_example: aliyun opensearch get-function-instance --app-group-identity 150057101 --function-name ctr --instance-name ctr_test --biz-output detail --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFunctionInstance

parameters.description_en:
Specifies the richness of returned information. Valid values:

- simple: displays only the basic information.

- normal: displays information such as createParameters and cron. This is the default value.

- detail: returns the details of the training task.
